note: The worked example for a capability call (include/app.h DECISION 4). A handler cannot reach a driver: it names a capability, and the kernel validates the arguments and performs it from the idle loop. hz is num(key), so one handler serves every note button - the key IS the frequency. 'into' names the field that shows what really happened: 'ok' once the sound has played, or the kernel's reason (on a machine with no audio driver, 'no audio driver'). The kernel starts at most one app sound every 500 ms, so leaning on a button gives 'too soon' rather than a queue of stale beeps.
